item.title: Saturnworks Active 2-way Buffered Splitter / Buffer Tuner Out with Volume Controls for Guitar or Bass Pedal - $67.15 ($10)
item.description:
A Saturnworks active splitter splits your signal without level or tone loss. 

Need to split your signal? Many players first reach for a Y-cable, but quickly learn that simply splitting a standard (high impedance) guitar signal with a Y-cable can kill your tone and cause signal loss. Putting a buffer before the split is better, but with that setup, the level of one side of the split may affect the level of the other side. 

The Saturnworks buffered splitter is the best way to keep your tone strong and clear and to eliminate signal interaction between channels. The volume control version adds volume controls to trim the level of each output. The Saturnworks buffered splitter isn't just a single buffer followed by a signal split. The "dual" in the Saturnworks dual active splitter means that this pedal takes one input signal and splits it into two individually buffered outputs. Each output has its own buffer. This keeps both signals strong and eliminates any levels interaction between channels. 

Interesting in setting up a parallel signal path for your rig? You can pair our active splitter with our 2-channel active summer to create a 2-channel parallel setup that allows you create unique blends of sounds. Or check out our listing for the Saturnworks parallel pedal that combines a 2-channel active splitter and 2-channel active summer into one convenient enclosure.

The buffered splitter also works great as an always-on tuner out.

This pedal can also be set up specifically for bass. If you'd like it set up for bass, please send us a message after you check to request the bass setup. 

The Saturnworks buffered splitter offers boutique grade components and features including: 

  • A cast-aluminum 4.39” 2.4″ x 1.24” (1590B size).
  • Heavy-duty Neutrik/Rean 1/4" TS jacks.
  • The buffered splitter is powered by standard 9v DC center-negative power with a top quality 2.1mm Lumberg brand power jack.
  • A current draw of approximately 3mA.
  • Power filtering for quieter operation.
  • An input impedance of 1M and an output impedance of <100 ohms. 
  • High quality wire made in the USA. 
  • Handcrafted and bench-tested in Washington, USA with US and imported components.
  • A 1-year limited warranty against parts and manufacturing defects. See saturnworkspedals.com for warranty terms and conditions.

Check out saturnworkspedals.com for the full Saturnworks lineup.

item.title: Strymon La Brea Analog Tape Drive Pedal - Used - $184.99 (FREE) [8% price drop]
item.description:
Sometimes, Inspiration Comes From Within.

It’s not often that your own gear inspires something completely different, but that’s just what happened with our new La Brea Analog Tape Drive.

An all-analog drive pedal that uses multi-stage tape saturation techniques to create driven tones ranging from mild breakup all the way to full fuzz, La Brea also features high frequency filtering and a fully variable dry output that always stays in phase with the original signal.

Your New Favorite Drive

Twelve years ago, our analog engineer Josh read the original white paper that Pete Celi wrote on the development of our popular Deco pedal. The paper inspired him to begin experimenting with some of the tape-centric techniques used in Deco in a full analog drive pedal design, and over ten years of tinkering later La Brea is the result.

La Brea feels completely natural to play, as the tape techniques create some pleasing natural compression along with the saturation and gain. Whether you’re looking to punch up some crispy open-string arpeggios or throw up a full wall of unique fuzz, La Brea can achieve it.

The inclusion of the phase-accurate dry path yields benefits that may not be immediately obvious, as it can help create an even bigger soundstage than saturation alone. The dry path can keep things clear and articulate if desired, and it can really help other drive pedals that are further down in the chain too, as some pedals need a strong transient to get the right sound.

La Brea’s operating voltage is internally boosted to 24 volts using a custom internal power supply, providing ample clarity and headroom. As a result the pedal can operate as a vibey clean boost if you prefer, or an all-out fuzz depending on where your amp and the Tape Sat knob on La Brea are set to.

Like all the other members of Series A, La Brea also features an internal jumper that determines the power-up state (moving the jumper to the second position will cause the pedal to turn itself on automatically when it sees power). This can really help if La Brea is buried under the second deck of a complex pedalboard, or in a rack drawer in a rack system.

Series A

Killer code only sounds killer when it’s hosted inside of an ideal analog environment, and even though we’re primarily known for our DSP prowess, our stuff wouldn’t sound the way that it does without our strong analog team.

The analog guys are always coming up with interesting designs, so we’ve launched the ‘Series A’ line of pure analog pedals to give them an outlet, with Fairfax being the first in the line.

The designs you’ll be seeing in ‘Series A’ are intended to offer something different from traditional Strymon offerings, with no MIDI, USB, firmware or digital processing. These will be pedals that are unabashedly analog, which means it could get really interesting! Keep an eye out for more ‘Series A’ pedals as we go forward.

Controls and Connections

SHIFT

Accentuates the high frequency content on both the saturation and clean signal paths.

high: increases the high-end for added sparkle.

flat: provides flat full-frequency response.

mid: increases the high midrange for added bite.

GAIN

Sets the TAPE SAT gain range.

high: enables higher gain.

norm: provides low to medium gain levels.

TAPE SAT

Adds soft-clipping, tape-style saturation. Lower settings add light overdrive and mild taming of transients. Higher levels provide heavy distortion, sustain, and fuzz textures. Use the GAIN switch to select the knob’s range.

LEVEL

Adjusts the output level of the Tape Saturation circuit.

DRY

Independently adjusts the clean signal path level from off to +6dB of boost.

Blend clean signal into a saturated tone for added dynamics. Or, decrease LEVEL to minimum to use the DRY on its own for a cut or clean boost.

FOOTSWITCH

Engages and bypasses the pedal. A lit amber LED indicates the pedal is engaged. Bypass is true bypass.

INPUT

High impedance JFET buffered mono instrument input.

OUTPUT

Low impedance mono output.

9VDC

Use a power supply or an adapter with the following ratings: 9VDC, center negative, 500mA minimum (sold separately).

Features

  • All-analog tape saturation drive initially inspired by our classic Deco pedal’s Saturation voices.
  • Full analog design – nothing digital in the signal path.
  • Gain switch to set the range of the Tape Saturation control.
  • Shift switch to enable a dedicated high frequency boost or a high frequency boost with added midrange frequencies for fatness and clarity.
  • Variable clean Dry path that is always in phase with the pedal’s saturated audio for adding clarity and fatness even with high saturation levels.
  • Runs at 24V internally to facilitate high headroom, a wide gain range and quiet operation.

Specs

  • Fully analog circuit.
  • True bypass.
  • Mono in/out.
  • Dimensions : 4.53″ deep x 2.83″ wide x 2.33″ tall (11.51 cm x 7.19 cm x 5.92 cm)
  • Power requirements — maximum 9 volts DC center-negative, with a minimum of 500mA (power supply not included).
